page_title: INT 3-2 JUV | Inter v Juventus 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Inter take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+4' What a chance! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance. Inter force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+3' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) latched on to a cross into the box and headed the ball under the crossbar. A decent header but it lacked power, allowing the goalkeeper to make a comfortable save.
90+2' A yellow-coloured card is received by Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

90' 3 - 2 Goal! Yann Bisseck sets up Piotr Zielinski (Inter) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom right corner. 3:2.

90' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
89' Michele Di Gregorio makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom left corner by Yann Bisseck (Inter).

88' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) replaces Marcus Thuram.
83' 2 - 2 Goal! Weston McKennie tees up Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 2:2.
81' Referee Federico La Penna has finally had enough of Cristian Chivu and brandishes a yellow card at him!
81' An attempted cross from Emil Holm (Juventus) is cleared.

80' What a huge chance for Federico Dimarco (Inter). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Juventus, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Yann Sommer (Inter).
78' Here is a change. Andrea Cambiaso is going off and Luciano Spalletti gives the last tactical orders to Lois Openda (Juventus).

76' 2 - 1 Federico Dimarco shows his great technique and produces a beautiful cross into the box. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) gets on the scoresheet by heading the ball precisely inside the right post. It's now 2:1.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kenan Yildiz trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jeremie Boga (Juventus).

75' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) latched on to a fine cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box. His shot, however, flies narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
75' The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
74' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 62:38.
72' Marcus Thuram (Inter) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
70' Weston McKennie (Juventus) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
68' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) stoops for a header low near the left post from a cross, but the goalkeeper pulls off a great save!
67' A snap shot by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Michele Di Gregorio produces a good save to thwart him.
67' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
66' Cristian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andy Diouf (Inter) replacing Petar Sucic.
66' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luis Henrique.
64' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts the ball.
61' Luciano Spalletti decides to make a substitution. Fabio Miretti will be replaced by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus).
61' The substitution is prepared. Juan Cabal (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jonathan David.
60' The foul by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) was seen by Federico La Penna who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
58' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
57' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Inter will take a free kick.
56' Federico Dimarco (Inter) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
54' Nicolo Barella will be replaced by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
53' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
51' Federico La Penna blows his whistle and it's Yann Bisseck (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
50' The keeper makes a simple save after Weston McKennie (Juventus) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.

50' Yann Sommer pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Fabio Miretti (Juventus) fired on target from the rebound. His effort from inside the box was directed low to the middle of the goal.
50' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the roof of the net, but Yann Sommer pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
49' Nicolo Barella (Inter) picks up a long through ball, but Michele Di Gregorio deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
48' Inter hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alessandro Bastoni is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Francisco Conceicao comes off for Emil Holm (Juventus).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Federico La Penna has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Nicolo Barella (Inter) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Lautaro Martinez (Inter).
42' RED CARD! Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Federico La Penna. He can have an early bath.
42' Oh, what a chance! Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) was quickest to the rebound but the ball hit the left post.
42' Marcus Thuram (Inter) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
41' Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

41' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
40' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
39' Juventus try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
38' Referee Federico La Penna sees the trip by Federico Dimarco (Inter) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Juventus get a free kick.

37' Juventus are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.

35' Good chance! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
35' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
32' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) has tested the patience of referee Federico La Penna and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
30' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) gets inside the box and tries to beat Yann Sommer with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
30' Federico Dimarco (Inter) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
26' 1 - 1 Goal! Weston McKennie plays a pass to the feet of Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:1.
25' Bremer (Juventus) commits a foul and Federico La Penna immediately signals a free kick.

22' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
20' Weston McKennie (Juventus) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Yann Sommer, who pulls off a stunning save!
19' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
17' 1 - 0 Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) deflects the ball past his own goalkeeper and into the goal after trying to jump in the way of a shot!
17' Some great controlled play and passing from Inter. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

14' Jonathan David (Juventus) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a throw-in.
12' Luis Henrique (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
11' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Federico La Penna has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
9' Petar Sucic (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
9' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) for his blatant foul.
8' Marcus Thuram (Inter) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
4' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half has started.
Juventus will kick the game off.
Federico La Penna will referee today's match.
